# Shanmugavel (Shanmu) — Digital Portfolio

> Shanmugavel (known as Shanmu) is a Tamil Nadu-based digital creator, full-stack developer, graphic designer, video editor, and entrepreneur with 5+ years of experience helping businesses grow online.

## About

Shanmugavel is the founder of Shadivi and VelzX — two digital ventures focused on simplifying how brands plan, publish, and grow. He works with startups, founders, and businesses across India to build high-impact digital assets including websites, brand identities, social media content, and digital marketing campaigns.

- **Full name**: Shanmugavel
- **Location**: Tamil Nadu, India
- **Experience**: 5+ years
